# contracts/scripts/check-prose.mjs.
# Format: <path relative to the repo root> -- <reason>

# Every entry is a file whose comments carry history, a plan reference,
# or a definition by contrast. The list is a measured backlog, seeded on
# 2026-09-11 when the gate first ran, and it is meant to shrink.

# A listed file with no finding fails the gate. Delete the entry when the
# file is fixed, or the gate stops gating that file.

# The advisory rules (NoComparison, NoNegation) never reach this file:
# they are warnings and do not block.
